messages:
devon: quick thread  can we finalize how quota spikes should interact with auto-fallbacks? saw a tenant flip twice in 10m during a retry storm.

leila: product stance: quota alone should not flip a rollout. it can mark "suspected" but require an corroborating signal (model errors or tail latency) or a sustained window.

sam: runtime can emit two classes: `probe_event` and `full_fallback_event`. probe_event = lightweight sampling + signal summary. full_fallback_event includes the policy snapshot. we'll add `trigger_tags` array.

charlie: SRE wants algorithmic smoothing: require either N consecutive buckets OR T seconds sustained breach. propose default N=4 buckets of 15s or T=90s. then apply a cooldown of 45s. also add operator-exempt override.

emma: UX take 1: show a compact status chip on the rollout row: e.g. "Auto-fallback: probing (quota)" -> opens drawer with timeline, sample coverage, and a human-friendly rationale. include "promote" and "pause" CTAs.

devon: auditability question: what fields do we persist for each probe vs fallback? compliance needs to replay decisions.

sam: audit event fields (stringified): "id", "type": probe|fallback, "trigger": token names, "route", "policy_version", "consecutive_buckets", "sample_rate", "operator_action". examples will be single-line JSON in logs.

leila: product insists operator actions be immutable with who/timestamp/policy-snapshot and a replay token. simulator must accept that token to reproduce the environment.

charlie: retention: full sampled traces for 14d, policy metadata and trigger counts for 365d. provide on-demand deep-retention export for legal holds. need cost estimate.

emma: UI note: show sample_rate and estimated coverage next to traces so operator understands representativeness. also surface a short "why" sentence auto-generated from the trigger fields.

sam: implementation note: add lightweight `fallback_tag` telemetry emitted to metrics backend so dashboards can aggregate cause-level rates without pulling traces. example metric label: fallback_reason=rate_quota.

devon: edge-case: if a tenant has very low volume, quota thresholds can be meaningless. we should have a min-volume guard that disables quota-triggered probes.

charlie: agree. add `min_requests_per_window` guard (default 50) before any quota-based probe can start. make configurable per-tenant.

leila: product asks that the drawer include a link to "show policy diff" so operator sees exactly what changed when the fallback was applied.

emma: also include a small timeline sparkline of error vs quota so it's obvious which co-varied.

sam: action items: add probe vs fallback events + trigger_tags + min_volume guard + metrics label. emit single-line audit JSON.

charlie: ops action: produce retention/cost estimate and cooldown defaults doc.

leila: product action: spec operator-audit schema + replay token requirements and UI flows for promote/pause.

devon: i'll coordinate a short RFC and a 30m sync Friday. thanks all. :pray:

opsbot: ci/rollouts/stage  deployed canary to 4 routes  all healthy.

emma: tiny follow-up: default sample_rate for quota probes = 0.5% but present obvious control in the drawer.

charlie: SGTM. make operator overrides time-bound to avoid stale holds.

devon: perfect, closing for now.
